About Figure

We’re Figure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Analyst, Portfolio Management to join our growing team! As Senior Analyst, Portfolio Management, you'll support our mortgage loan servicing oversight function with the analysis, reporting, and day-to-day monitoring that keep servicing efficient, compliant, and effective at reducing delinquency and losses. You'll work closely with Portfolio Management leadership to evaluate loss mitigation and default strategies, track how customers in financial hardship are engaged, and refine programs that put borrowers on a long-term path to cure. You'll also keep our data, processes, and systems aligned so key stakeholders (Customer, Company, and Investors) get clear, accurate visibility into portfolio performance. If you want to turn servicing data into decisions that cut delinquency and are ready to own the numbers, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Support the servicing operations team on portfolio oversight and strategic initiatives across our internal Servicing organization and Sub-Servicing partners
  • Gather, analyze, and monitor data to carry out and improve collections strategies that balance customer experience with recovery goals, reduce delinquency rates, and maximize recoveries
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), spot trends, and prepare analysis that informs decisions and operational improvements for internal Servicing and Sub-Servicing partners
  • Reconcile servicing transfer reports and investigate data inaccuracies or discrepancies
  • Support data alignment and validation with sub-servicers as part of portfolio oversight
  • Monitor sub-servicer performance and service-level adherence, and prepare materials for partner reviews
  • Work with Capital Markets, Credit, Risk Management, Finance, and Legal teams to research and resolve servicing and collections issues
  • Identify and document risks related to loan servicing and collections, and help develop mitigation recommendations
  • Help keep servicing and collections activity compliant with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including CFPB requirements and the FDCPA, and flag potential issues to leadership

What We Look For

  • 3–5 years of experience in financial services or consumer lending, preferably in mortgage or HELOC servicing, collections, loss mitigation, or portfolio analytics
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations related to loan servicing and collections
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills
  • Understanding of basic financial analysis and accounting principles
  • Interpret data and turn it into clear reports, summaries, and presentations
  • Check data carefully, especially in reconciliation and validation
  • Explain findings clearly in writing and in conversation, and work comfortably with teams across the company
  • Manage multiple priorities at once
  • Travel up to 10% of the time
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field (preferred)
  • SQL or BI tools (for example, Looker, Tableau) (preferred)
  • Exposure to collection and default management strategies (preferred)
  • Experience with loan origination or servicing systems (for example, Black Knight MSP, Sagent) (preferred)
  • Experience working with third-party sub-servicers or vendors (preferred)
  • Experience in a start-up or consulting environment (preferred)
  • Experience using Notion and Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides) (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $91,728 - $137,592/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

S vývojem naší aplikace bmc-main, která běží nejen na Braiins Decku, ale nově i na Braiins Mini Mineru 101. Najdeš ji na GitHubu. Naší snahou je uživatelům přinést otevřený ekosystém, do kterého budou chtít sami přispívat.

  • Zajímavé technické výzvy v oblasti bitcoinového hardwaru i mimo ni.

  • Full-time spolupráci formou plného úvazku nebo smlouvy.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Developer Productivity group is responsible for making Stripe’s developers happy and productive. We work on tools, processes, and code refactoring to accelerate Stripe engineering as Stripe scales.

We’re looking for people with an interest in building the tools to improve the day to day experience of Engineers in Stripe. The ideal candidate will have a mix of technical expertise in either language processing tools, version control systems, contract testing, build systems, but most importantly a passion for solving developer experience problems, and a pragmatic ability to ship results iteratively. You’ll be working on a mix of fault tolerant distributed systems and also software which runs on individual developer machines.

What you’ll do

We work with a code base of several million lines of code (and counting), used by hundreds of engineers across the globe, who initiate dozens of build jobs per minute. What we do is key to allowing Stripe engineers working in our main business logic layer to have the most productive time of their careers while building and running the features that Stripe and its customers need in order to thrive.

Responsibilities

  • Efficiently scaling a fleet of 10,000s of CI workers, balancing the competing priorities of minimising user-facing queuing while also minimising cost and increasing reliability.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Stripe’s engineering management team
  • Owning the end-to-end experience of how our users engage with CI. This includes working with our users to understand pain points, and deliver incremental, or step-change improvements to their day-to-day workflows across multiple languages, with a higher focus on Java and Ruby.
  • Developing & maintaining state-of-the-art developer tooling and increasing tooling reliability.
  • Work with other Stripe leaders to design and lead developer productivity best practice
  • Empower the engineering team to achieve a high level of technical productivity, reliability, and simplicity
  • Recruit great engineers, in collaboration with Stripe’s recruiting team
  • Help engineers advance in their careers and develop new skills
  • Work with your users to ensure the capabilities they need to safely, and reliably, deploy to production are available.
  • Supporting efficient inter-service testing to support teams developing new services, or migrating existing services, to Stripe’s modern service oriented architecture.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of people management experience
  • Hands-on experience building tools that are used daily by other developers (e.g. CI, build support, devboxes)
  • A passion for supporting developer productivity 
  • Successfully recruited and built great teams
  • The ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility
  • Clear and persuasive writing and in-person communication

Preferred qualifications

  • You have managed teams that designed and operated critical infrastructure, particularly with a broad remit across core capabilities, builds, and quality
  • You are empathetic to customer needs but visionary enough to not just deliver a faster horse
  • You are comfortable planning in quarters, and can set a vision for several years
  • You are excited about collaborating with teammates across Stripe’s organization, to provide a wonderful user experience for key developer workflows
  • You are comfortable working with geographically distributed teams

At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. You will own products from the first conversation about a problem to the moment customers use them, and keep improving them after launch. You will own products and features end to end, meaning from working with a customer to shipping something to have impact.

We expect you to combine incredible bias to AI with great technical taste and hard work. Own problems, build products, ship value. At all times, you are responsible for the code you write, so you must be able to write, understand and debug code. Fast implementation only matters when the product solves the right problem and works reliably.

This is a demanding role with substantial ownership. You will learn unfamiliar domains quickly, make decisions with incomplete information and put sustained effort into getting difficult things over the line. You will have a lot of say about how you design features and how our product looks like.

  • Months 1-3: Launch one new product to customers.

  • Months 4-6: Own and iteratively improve one product.

  • Months 7-12: Own and launch new products. Build an enablement system for agents around launching the products you own.

 

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You see an awkward workflow and start figuring out how to make it better. You can show us something you took from an idea to a working product, and explain the decisions you made.

  • You learn unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask precise questions, find the underlying constraints and change your mind when the evidence changes.

  • You care a LOT about product experience: API naming, sensible defaults, loading states, clear errors and what happens when something fails.

  • You use agents to attempt more ambitious work. You can show how you steer them, catch their mistakes and verify the result.

  • You move quickly and work hard. When a project gets difficult, you narrow the problem, seek help where needed and keep ownership until it works.

  • You can choose the smallest useful solution and still insist on correctness, security and a good user experience.

  • You want responsibility that grows with your ability. Your strongest evidence might come from a startup, a job, open-source work or something you built independently.

This is not for you if:

  • You need others to get your stuff done.

  • You do not enjoy talking to customers.

  • You vibe code stuff without adding quality gates and correctness checks.

  • You treat product decisions as someone else's responsibility.

  • You are not able to pick up new complex domains quickly.

  • You do not enjoy working long hours.

Hard Requirements

Must Haves:

  • At least one working product or substantial feature you personally built and can discuss in depth. Commercial, independent and open-source work all count; confidential work can be discussed without sharing private code.

  • Hands-on use of coding agents, including the ability to review their output and identify incorrect or unsafe behavior.

  • Based in Berlin or open to relocate.

Strong preference:

  • Experience shipping a product with real users and improving it from feedback.

  • Evidence of unusually strong independent work: a useful side project, meaningful open-source contributions, a company you built or substantial ownership in a small team.

  • Experience with APIs, payments or financial products. Banking experience is useful, but not required.

  • There is no minimum number of years of experience or degree requirement. We assess demonstrated ability and scope of ownership.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €70,000-€100,000 + equity and benefits.

The successful candidate will be an exceptional communicator, highly organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. What you’ll do:

  • Build a contract recruiting team that performs like a top in-house team. You’ll set a high bar for your contract recruiters, assign searches by domain and capacity, coach them on sourcing and closing, and run pipeline reviews that lead to action. You’ll make direct calls on who stays, who grows and who rolls off.
  • Hire the technical talent and engineers who will shape Ripple’s next chapter. You’ll personally own Ripple’s most critical technical searches, including Staff+ and Principal engineers, engineering leaders, and domain specialists in protocol, distributed systems, security, and infrastructure.
